Step.description: A step, forbidden action or warning sign that names a tool, is required, or (steps only) has `or` options.

text.description: What the agent should do (or never do, or watch for).
text.title: Text

tool.description: Name of a tool the agent has (e.g. a LiveKit function tool). Rendered as an instruction to use it, and checked against the call's tool log.
tool.title: Tool

required.description: Steps only: skipping this step, or its tool call, fails the check even if the goal was met another way. With a tool, the call is checked against the tool log.
required.title: Required

or.description: Steps only: alternatives to this step, each usually starting with its condition ("If ..."). On a call, only one of the step and its options applies. Options have no `or` of their own.
or.title: Or

Step.title: Step

Option.description: An `or` option of a step: the same fields as a step, without `or`.

text.description: What the agent should do (or never do, or watch for).
text.title: Text

tool.description: Name of a tool the agent has (e.g. a LiveKit function tool). Rendered as an instruction to use it, and checked against the call's tool log.
tool.title: Tool

required.description: Steps only: skipping this step, or its tool call, fails the check even if the goal was met another way. With a tool, the call is checked against the tool log.
required.title: Required

Option.title: Option

description: A procedure the agent follows. Written as procedures/<id>.yaml; procedures/<id>.md (Markdown) holds the same fields, with only delivery in its front matter. It says nothing about which agents use it; agents list it in `blocks`.

id.description: The file name without .yaml or .md. Set automatically; if you write it, it must match.
id.title: Id

name.description: Heading shown in the prompt, e.g. "Allergen check".
name.title: Name

delivery.description: "prompt": the whole SOP is in the prompt. "auto": name, scope, forbidden actions and warning signs are in the prompt; the agent fetches the rest with the get_sop tool. "tool": only name and scope are in the prompt.
delivery.title: Delivery

description.description: The goal: the outcome that means this SOP succeeded. QA uses it to go easier on skipped steps when the goal was still met.
description.title: Description

scope.description: When this SOP applies: the situation that should trigger it.
scope.title: Scope

guidance.description: Free text that isn't a step, forbidden action or warning sign: context, nuance, examples.
guidance.title: Guidance

procedureSteps.description: Ordered steps; at least one. Each is a string, or {text, tool, required, or}.
procedureSteps.title: Proceduresteps

forbiddenActions.description: Things the agent must never do. Each is a string, or {text, tool}.
forbiddenActions.title: Forbiddenactions

warningSigns.description: Situations that need special handling, usually an escalation. Each is a string, or {text, tool}.
warningSigns.title: Warningsigns

title: sop SOP: procedures/<id>.yaml
